name: Supreme court
description: Follow Supreme court, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump Signs Executive Orders Targeting Birthright Citizenship and ‘Birth Tourism’
changes.summary: The orders come after the Supreme Court ruled June 30 that President Trump’s previous efforts to end birthright citizenship were unconstitutional.

changes.title: Warren presses U.S. companies to share tariff refunds with customers
changes.summary: Companies receiving billions in refunds for U.S. tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court should return money to consumers, Sen. Elizabeth Warren said.

changes.title: Appeals Court Upholds Block on Trump Ballroom Construction
changes.summary: A federal appeals court panel backed a lower court’s ruling, and made it likely that the Supreme Court will decide the case. But the decision does not mean construction will halt immediately.

changes.title: Trump mounts new effort to fire Fed's Lisa Cook after Supreme Court ruling
changes.summary: The White House has informed Lisa Cook, a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors, that President Trump is considering firing her.

changes.title: Trump renews push to fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook
changes.summary: Trump is once again threatening to fire Cook over unproven allegations of mortgage fraud after an earlier effort to remove Cook was struck down by the Supreme Court. (Image credit: Kevin Dietsch).

changes.title: Another court blocks White House ballroom work, teeing up a Supreme Court review
changes.summary: A federal appeals court says above-ground construction cannot continue without approval from Congress, siding with historic preservation advocates. (Image credit: Tierney L. Cross).

changes.title: Trump administration proceeds with efforts to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook
changes.summary: The Trump administration is moving ahead with its efforts to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook, two months after the Supreme Court allowed her to retain her job while she fights the president's effort to terminate her over mortgage fraud allegations that she has denied.

changes.title: Appeals court rules Trump can't build White House ballroom without congressional approval
changes.summary: Trump said in a post on social media that he would be appealing what he called an "unjust decision" to the U.S. Supreme Court.

changes.title: Trump Restarts Battle to Fire Sitting Fed Governor Lisa Cook
changes.summary: The Trump administration, rebuffed by the Supreme Court in its first attempt to fire Lisa D. Cook, sent the Federal Reserve governor a letter saying it was “considering” removing her from the job.

changes.title: Trump issues new executive orders aimed at birthright citizenship
changes.summary: The Supreme Court in June struck down President Trump's earlier executive order aimed at ending birthright citizenship.
